signup.name: Your name

Onboarding.heading: Let's start your diary
Onboarding.subtitle: Create a new diary, or join one with the code you were given.

create.title: Create a new diary
create.description: You go first — a code is generated afterwards so you can invite whoever you want.
create.errorGeneric: Couldn't create the diary. Try again.

join.title: Join with a code
join.description: If a diary already exists, ask for the invite code and join it here.
join.errorInvalid: Invalid code. Double-check it with whoever shared it with you.

Home.heading: A personal archive of your life together: firsts, highlights and fragments.
Home.rouletteCardDescription: A random spin brings up a unique moment: your first day skiing, your first anniversary…
Home.timelineCardDescription: Every memory you add, in chronological order.

Roulette.heading: Spin and discover a moment
Roulette.empty: No memories are marked for the roulette yet.
Roulette.emptyHint: Add one and turn on “Show in roulette”.

Timeline.heading: Your story, in order
Timeline.hint: Tap a point to expand the memory. Drag sideways or use the arrows to see more dates.
Timeline.empty: There are no memories on the timeline yet.
Timeline.emptyHint: Add one and turn on “Show on timeline”.
